description: Thotahewage Sukitha Lakmal de Silva v. Hon. Attorney General Thotahewage Sukitha Lakmal de Silva v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. L.T.B. Dehideniya, J
parties: Thotahewage Sukitha Lakmal de Silva v. Hon. Attorney General Thotahewage Sukitha Lakmal de Silva v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Revision of sentence – Abduction of girl under 16 – Statutory rape on two consecutive days – Convictions not challenged – Prosecutrix and accused had been in a consensual relationship – Consent legally irrelevant to offence but relevant to sentence – Maximum 20-year sentences – Judicial discretion in sentencing – Mandatory minimum sentence constitutionally problematic – Circumstances distinguished from forcible rape – Custodial portions set aside – Two years rigorous imprisonment on second charge suspended for ten years – Fines and compensation preserved. P.R. Walgama J. agreed.
legistation: Penal Code – section 364(2)(e); Constitution – Articles 4(c), 11 and 12(1).
